title: How to Migrate My Agency Over to KenjiAI Email
html:
If you are an existing client with Mailgun or SMTP integrated KenjiAI, please follow the guide below. 

If you are a 'New Agency' and have not integrated any SMTP/Mailgun provider you are already on KenjiAI Email by default. You can check by testing



KenjiAI Email is designed to help agencies avoid the hassle of signing up for Mailgun or any 3rd party email service provider. In the past, when an agency signed up they would need to either integrate with Mailgun or another email service provider to send/receive emails.

With KenjiAI Email, sending & receiving email works right out of the box, on every subaccount. This article will help you migrate your Agency and sub-accounts over to the KenjiAI Email.


Covered in this Article:

How to migrate over to KenjiAI Email

How to check if you are on KenjiAI Email server (Video).

How to migrate over to KenjiAI Email


Head into your Agency Settings > Email Services. If you see the button 'Use KenjiAI Email' please select KenjiAI as the default provider and follow the prompts:
 





Please Note:

Clicking the 'Use KenjiAI Email' button will not affect sub-accounts that already have SMTP or Mailgun integrated, please follow the steps below to remove the existing SMTP integration. 

After clicking the 'Use KenjiAI Email' button all new accounts will automatically switch over to KenjiAI Email. You can still configure new accounts away from KenjiAI Email by integrating your own Mailgun or SMTP.


If you are trying to add the domain/subdomain but it is showing the following error:

Request Failed

This domain (replies.example.com) is already configured inside a Mailgun account.

Login to Mailgun and delete it from there so you can use it in KenjiAI Email

Please Create a New Support Request if you believe the domain should be deleted.


To remove the SMTP integration:


1. Select KenjiAI as the Default provider

2. click on the Gmail integration

3. Click the trash icon



How to check if you are on KenjiAI Email server (Video).
